title: Guard Gallivant
description: Simulate a guard patrol and find obstacle positions that create loops.
writeup:
## Approach

Simulate a guard moving on a grid who turns right 90° whenever the next cell is an obstacle.

## Part 1

Track every cell the guard visits until they leave the grid. The answer is the number of distinct visited positions.

## Part 2

Find how many positions could hold a new obstacle that would trap the guard in a loop. Only positions on the original path need to be tested (an obstacle elsewhere wouldn't change the path). For each candidate, re-simulate and detect a loop by checking if the guard revisits the same (row, col, direction) state.
